usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the valid IPSet and Alias names that can be placed in the source/dest fields of cluster firewall rules. Call it before constructing or validating a firewall rule to confirm a reference name exists at cluster scope. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path; filter by the optional `type` param to narrow results to either aliases or IPSets.

examples.summary: List only IPSet references available for use in cluster firewall rules

tips: Omit the `type` param to return both aliases and IPSets in a single call.
The `ref` field in each result is the exact token to use in a firewall rule's source or dest property (e.g., `+ipset-name` or `dc/alias-name`).
This endpoint only surfaces cluster-scope references; node- or VM-level aliases/IPSets defined elsewhere will not appear here.
